hook: *13* roads, 43.38 km, Rs 37.13 crore: Maheshwaram works begin
hook_b: *13* roads, 43.38 km, Rs 37.13 crore: Maheshwaram works begin
tldr: Panchayat Raj Minister Seethakka laid the foundation stone on Nov 21 for 13 roads in Maheshwaram constituency of Rangareddy district.

beats.what: A plaque was unveiled at Mohabbatnagar gram panchayat on the Srisailam Highway to mark the start of works.
beats.why: The roads come under the state's Hybrid Annuity Model programme for rural roads.
beats.care: Villages along the Srisailam Highway stretch in Maheshwaram should see road works begin.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Local MLA Sabitha Indra Reddy and MLC Balmuri Venkat attended the launch.

cards.q: Which matters more for roads near you?

qs: How are Hybrid Annuity roads maintained once built?

facts.t: The package covers *13* roads totalling 43.38 km in one constituency.

viz.verdict: Works formally start; no end date given

steps.e: Cheyutha pension sanction letters handed out

learn.t: Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) = a road-building model where government and builder share the cost

watch: The report does not give a completion deadline for the 13 roads.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Seethakka lays foundation stone for 13 roads worth ₹37.13 crore in Maheshwaram

fact: Maheshwaram gets *13* new roads covering 43.38 km for Rs 37.13 crore
twist: The same day, sanction letters for newly approved Cheyutha pensions were handed out in Maheshwaram village.
